C9000031.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 031 (Uchida’s conjecture for open homomorphisms of Galois groups.; papers: Open Homomorphisms of Global Solvably Closed Galois Groups; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN.statement: The manuscript's full open-homomorphism theorem. This campaign-level claim remains open.

C_IDENTIFICATION.statement: Identify the normalized map and deduce prosolvable rigidity; not audited in this bounded mission.

C_SAME_CHARACTERISTIC.statement: Almost every split target prime has an active source partner with the same residue characteristic.

C_FINITE_FIBERS.statement: The source-partner sets are finite for almost every split target prime.

C_NORMALIZED.statement: Surjectivity and logarithmic cyclotomic compatibility at all eligible odd primes; an upstream hypothesis of the bridge, not established here.

C_AMPLIFICATION.statement: Normalizer extension, quotient amplification, and Frobenius generation with the manuscript's exact finite-group actions.

C_LOG_RANK.statement: The logarithm-rank lemma and Frobenius-detection consequences, using the actual unit-logarithm image; not verified here.

C_SIGNED_REPRESENTATION.statement: The character space contains the induced sign representation, embeds in the regular representation, and has faithful finite Galois action.

C_POWER_SEPARATION.statement: Simultaneous separation by power residues, including overlapping prime lists.

L_NORM_IDENTITY.statement: The tame conjugation calculation gives (Nv)^b(g)=(Nw)^a(g) in Z_ell^times for an active pair.

C_ANABELIAN_INPUTS.statement: Verify the distinct external anabelian inputs and solvable-closure reductions used by the full manuscript; the uniform-bridge mission inspected only Uchida's odd-prime local input.

C_UNIFORM.statement: Under the exact normalized-map hypotheses, prove the uniform missed-prime bound for every eligible ell. The written proof and sharper multiplicity formula await independent review.

L_KUMMER_COMPLETE.statement: Equivariant unramified Kummer identification via the S-class-group exact sequence and its multiplication-by-ell transition, without finite valuation support.

L_TWIST_INJECT.statement: Pullback and restriction preserve independence, and the natural action has epsilon-inverse eigenvalue; exact conjugation and averaging identities are replayed.

L_RAMIFICATION.statement: All pulled-back missed-prime classes are unramified away from ell, even when the finite twist extension is ramified there.

L_MULTIPLICITY.statement: The exact S-unit character multiplicity is the number of orbits whose stabilizer the character kills, minus the trivial-character correction; for the faithful twist this gives (1).
